def VTask.subtypePreimage : {α : Sort u_1} → {β : Sort u_4} → (p : α → Prop) → [DecidablePred p] → (x₀ : { a // p a } → β) → { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a // ¬p a } → β) := by
  intro α β p _ x₀
  have h₁ : {x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀} ≃ ({a // ¬p a} → β) := by
    -- Define the equivalence by constructing the forward and backward mappings
    apply Equiv.ofBijective (fun (f : {x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀}) => fun (a : {a // ¬p a}) => f.val a.val)
    -- Prove that the mapping is injective
    constructor
    · -- Injectivity
      intro f g h
      have h₂ : f.val ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := f.prop
      have h₃ : g.val ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := g.prop
      have h₄ : ∀ (a : {a // ¬p a}), f.val a.val = g.val a.val := by
        intro a
        exact h a
      have h₅ : ∀ (a : α), f.val a = g.val a := by
        intro a
        by_cases ha : p a
        · -- Case: p a
          have h₆ : Subtype.val (⟨a, ha⟩ : {a // p a}) = a := rfl
          have h₇ : f.val a = x₀ ⟨a, ha⟩ := by
            have h₈ : (f.val ∘ Subtype.val) ⟨a, ha⟩ = x₀ ⟨a, ha⟩ := by
              rw [h₂]
            simp [h₆] at h₈ ⊢
            exact h₈
          have h₉ : g.val a = x₀ ⟨a, ha⟩ := by
            have h₁₀ : (g.val ∘ Subtype.val) ⟨a, ha⟩ = x₀ ⟨a, ha⟩ := by
              rw [h₃]
            simp [h₆] at h₁₀ ⊢
            exact h₁₀
          rw [h₇, h₉]
        · -- Case: ¬p a
          have h₆ : ¬p a := ha
          have h₇ : f.val a = (fun (a : {a // ¬p a}) => f.val a.val) ⟨a, h₆⟩ := by
            simp [Subtype.ext_iff]
          have h₈ : g.val a = (fun (a : {a // ¬p a}) => g.val a.val) ⟨a, h₆⟩ := by
            simp [Subtype.ext_iff]
          rw [h₇, h₈]
          have h₉ : (fun (a : {a // ¬p a}) => f.val a.val) ⟨a, h₆⟩ = (fun (a : {a // ¬p a}) => g.val a.val) ⟨a, h₆⟩ := by
            apply h
          rw [h₉]
      -- Since f.val and g.val are equal everywhere, the structures f and g are equal
      have h₆ : f.val = g.val := by
        funext a
        exact h₅ a
      have h₇ : f.prop = g.prop := by
        rw [h₆]
      exact Subtype.ext h₆
    · -- Surjectivity
      intro (f : {a // ¬p a} → β)
      -- Define a function that extends x₀ and f to all of α
      use ⟨fun (a : α) => if ha : p a then x₀ ⟨a, ha⟩ else f ⟨a, ha⟩, by
        -- Prove that this function agrees with x₀ on {a // p a}
        funext (a : {a // p a})
        simp [Subtype.ext_iff]
        <;> aesop⟩
      -- Prove that the mapping is surjective
      intro (a : {a // ¬p a})
      simp [Subtype.ext_iff]
      <;> aesop
  exact h₁
